course_units.title: Welcome to school
key_expressions: Hello. My name is Amy!
I'm Sam.
I'm Daming.
Hi! I'm Lingling. What's your name?
I'm Bobo.
Goodbye, Bobo. Have a nice day!
Good morning! I'm Ms Smart.
Good morning, Ms Smart!

course_units.title: Unit 1 Let’s be friends!
key_expressions: Hello! Hello! Nice to meet you.
Let's be friends! Let's play.
Let's have a happy day!
Hi, everyone! I'm Sam. I'm nine.
She's Amy. She's nine, too.
We're from the UK. We're twins!
Hi, Sam. Hi, Amy. I'm Lingling. He's Daming.
Come and play! We are friends!
Here you are. Thank you.

course_units.title: Unit 2 My school things
key_expressions: Pack my bag for school.
Amy! What's this? - It's my schoolbag.
What's this? - It's a book.
What's this? - It's a pen.
Is it a pen, too? - No, it isn't. It's a pencil.
What's that, Tom? - It's you, Amy!
Is this your pen, Yoyo? - Yes, it is. Thank you.
Is this your ruler, Lulu? - No, it isn't. It's my eraser / ruler.
Take care of your school things!
Look at your schoolbag!

course_units.title: Unit 3 It’s a colourful world!
key_expressions: Look at our umbrellas, Look at our clothes.
Red, pink, green and yellow, Orange, blue and purple!
I want a balloon!
- What colour is it? Can you guess? - It's blue! / It's red!
What colour is F? - It's red!
Today is National Day. Everyone, let's come and paint!
This is a colourful picture for the happy National Day!

course_units.title: Unit 4 Fun with numbers
culture_and_nature: Numbers in nature (雪花six、瓢虫eight、章鱼seven)
key_expressions: How many birds can you see? One, two, three!
This is a Chinese knot.
Guess! How many ropes? - Six? Twelve? - Ha ha, no. Look! Only one rope!
How many pencils? - Three.
How many erasers? - One.
Twelve eggs. Twelve babies. Er, I'm hungry.
Oh, no! Only eleven eggs.
Let me count. One, two... twelve. Twelve babies!
Numbers are all around. Big numbers, little numbers. I see numbers everywhere!

course_units.title: Unit 5 We’re family
key_expressions: Dad, mum, brother, sister, grandpa, grandma and me. This is my family.
Sam, this is my dad. This is my grandpa.
That is my grandma! - But who is that? - Oh, this is my grandma.
I'm Jiajia. This is my sister.
Oh, no! The cap! Come back, Lucky!
Don't worry! We can help!
Grandma, Grandpa, Dad, Mum, come on!
This is my family photo. I love my family.
Come on, Daddy! Come on, Mummy! Come on, Brother! Let's take a photo together.
Oh, where's the dog? It's in the orange box!

course_units.title: Unit 6 My sweet home
key_expressions: Who is in the living room / bedroom / bathroom / kitchen / dining room?
Dad, where's Susu? - She's in the living room. On the chair, I think.
Mum, where's Susu? - Look in the bedroom. She's under the bed.
Susu is in the box with four little babies!
Where is the ball? - It's under the table.
The black cat is on the table.
This is my home. A bedroom and a living room.
Who are you? You are in my bedroom! - No, you're in my living room!
No home for us now! Look at the apple! Let's make a new home there... and share it!
This is our sweet home!
Dad's in the kitchen. Cooking is fun. Mum's in the living room. She loves the sun.

key_dialogue: Mouse: Hello! I am Mouse.
Deer: Hello! I am Deer. He is Rabbit.
Rabbit: We’re friends. Let’s play together! - Mouse: Great!
Deer: Hunter! Run, friends!
Deer & Mouse: (The hunter gets Rabbit.) Oh, no. Let’s help Rabbit! We are friends.
Hunter: Ha ha! A deer! (Hunter runs after Deer.)
Rabbit: (Mouse helps Rabbit to get out.) Great! I’m out. Let’s run!
Rabbit: Thank you, friends! - Deer & Mouse: Friends help each other.
Mulan: I am Mulan. I have a happy family. This is my dad. This is my mum. That’s my little brother.
Mulan: Dad, you are worried. Why? - Dad: I must join the army.
Mulan: But our family needs you. My brother is only five. I have an idea.
Mulan: Dad, Mum, look! I’m ready. - Mum: No, don’t go!
Mulan: Please let me go. For our family, and for our country.
Dad: Well… OK. Take care, my girl. - Brother: Bye-bye, dear sister.
Mulan: (After 12 years) Great! I can go home now. Let’s go, brother!
Mulan’s family: Mulan, you’re back! We missed you so much! - Mulan: I missed you, too!
Soldier 1: Who’s that? - Soldier 2: Mulan, are you a girl? - Mulan: Yes!
Soldiers: Wow! You are a great girl, for your family and for the country!

appendices_plays.play_title: Goldilocks and the three bears (金发姑娘和三只熊)
key_dialogue: Goldilocks: Hello! Anyone home? Your door is open.
Goldilocks: This is a nice living room. Two big chairs and one small chair are next to the window.
Goldilocks: It’s the kitchen. Two big bowls and one small bowl are on the table.
Goldilocks: Oh, two big beds and one small bed. I’m in the bedroom.
Papa Bear: The door is open. Who is in our house? - Mama Bear: Let’s see.
Baby Bear: Who is in my bed?
Goldilocks: (wakes up) I’m sorry! - The Bears: It’s OK. But don’t do this again. - Goldilocks: OK.
